x: We used to train on Tuesdays and Thursdays from Chelsea Barracks, tearing it up on the Hyde Park horse rides, plus the Saturday Inter-Club races, or training runs over the country; from those days I remember, Tom Carter, Bill Lucas, Bert Footer, Steve Charlton and many others".
Charlie went one better in the M60 5000m winning in 20:15.3, a good time in the hot conditions, although at M65 Steve Charlton flew round in an amazing 18:04.7 recording a new CBP.
Pat was less than half a minute behind the in form M65 winner Steve Charlton. Next was Charlie Walker, running a great deal better than he himself believed.

The Belgrave 10 mile Cross Country Championship at this time resulted in a win for Jack Brown in 59:31 from Steve Charlton and Bill Lucas.
